description: Versioned ceilings for tools/ops/server_soak.py and tools/ops/evaluate_server_alerts.py. Provisional harness guards with headroom for shared-runner noise, not governed SLOs. Changing any value requires a version bump.

rssSlopeBytesPerHour.rationale: Least-squares RSS slope over the post-warm-up window. 64 MiB/h absorbs allocator noise yet still trips a steady leak of a few KiB per tick (1 KiB/tick at 60 Hz is about 211 MiB/h).

rssGrowthBytes.rationale: Peak-minus-first RSS in the fit window. 32 MiB bounds a one-off allocator step while a leak still shows as sustained growth.

tickP95Us.rationale: A 60 Hz tick has a 16.7 ms budget; p95 must fit inside half of it.

tickP99Us.rationale: A 60 Hz tick has a 16.7 ms budget; p99 must fit inside it.

netQueueSlopePerHour.rationale: Reliable traffic is never dropped, so a growing queue depth is unbounded. One message per second of sustained growth reaches the 4096 cap in about 68 minutes.

netQueueCap.rationale: NetworkManager::kMaxQueuedMessages: Unreliable traffic past this depth is shed, so a queue peak at the cap means traffic was already being lost.

minTickRateFraction.rationale: The achieved tick rate must average at least half of the requested rate; a lower rate means the server is falling behind.
